news.title: Artturi Lehkonen and Cale Makar lead the Avalanche to a 5-2 victory over the Flames
news.ruTitle: Арттури Лехконен и Кале Макар привели «Эвеланш» к победе над «Флэймз» со счетом 5:2.
news.description: — Artturi Lehkonen scored twice, Nathan MacKinnon had a goal and an assist, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Calgary Flames 5-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Which player has the most career points in NHL history?
news.ruTitle: Какой игрок набрал наибольшее количество карьерных очков в истории НХЛ?
news.description: Wayne Gretzky leads the list of NHL players with the most career points. Check out other top performers now.

news.title: Who has scored the most goals in NHL history?
news.ruTitle: Кто забил больше всего голов в истории НХЛ?

news.title: Harley and Hyry score buzzer-beaters in the Stars' 3-1 win over the Blue Jackets
news.ruTitle: Харли и Хайри забили голы в победном матче «Старз» над «Блю Джекетс» со счетом 3:1.
news.description: — Defenseman Thomas Harley scored with 0.2 seconds left in the first period and Arttu Hyry added an empty-netter with 0.3 left in the game as the Dallas Stars beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 3-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Canadiens beat the Penguins 5-4 for their 5th straight victory
news.ruTitle: «Канадиенс» обыграли «Пингвинз» со счетом 5–4 и одержали пятую победу подряд.
news.description: — Josh Anderson had two goals and an assist and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-4 on Saturday night for their fifth straight victory.

news.title: Auston Matthews scores his 11th goal of the season to help the Maple Leafs beat the Canucks 4-2
news.ruTitle: Остон Мэтьюз забивает свой 11-й гол в сезоне, помогая «Мэйпл Лифс» обыграть «Кэнакс» со счетом 4–2.
news.description: — Auston Matthews scored his 11th goal of the season and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-2 on Saturday night to end a two-game losing streak,

news.title: Tage Thompson scores twice as Sabres extend road point streak to 7 with 3-2 win over Kings
news.ruTitle: Тейдж Томпсон забивает дважды, а «Сэйбрз» увеличили серию очков до 7 благодаря победе над «Кингз» со счетом 3–2
news.description: — Tage Thompson scored twice, including the go-ahead goal with 6:20 remaining, and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Los Angeles Kings 3-2 on Saturday to extend their road point streak to seven games.

news.title: Stützle, Cozens lead Senators past Sharks 5-1 as Ottawa ties franchise record with nine October wins
news.ruTitle: Штютцле и Козенс обыграли «Шаркс» со счетом 5:1, а «Оттава» установила рекорд франшизы, одержав девять побед в октябре.
news.description: — Tim Stützle and Dylan Cozens each had a goal and an assist and the Ottawa Senators defeated the San Jose Sharks 5-1 on Saturday.

news.title: Halloween 2026: Breaking down top athlete costumes from across the sports world
news.ruTitle: Хэллоуин 2026: Разбираем костюмы лучших спортсменов со всего спортивного мира
news.description: Athletes far and wide across the sports world showed off special costumes for Halloween.

news.title: Heineman ejected from Islanders' loss to Oilers after hit on Howard
news.ruTitle: Хейнеман вылетел после поражения от «Айлендерс» от «Ойлерз» после удара по Ховарду
news.description: Emil Heineman was ejected after the New York Islanders forward injured Edmonton's Isaac Howard with a knee-on-knee hit Saturday afternoon, though the Oilers had a positive report after their 4-0 victory.

news.title: Stamkos scores in regulation and only goal in shootout to lead Predators over Lightning 5-4
news.ruTitle: Стэмкос забивает в основном матче и единственный гол в серии пенальти, благодаря которому «Хищники» обыграли «Лайтнинг» со счетом 5–4.
news.description: — Steven Stamkos scored the tying goal in regulation and the only goal of the shootout to lead the Nashville Predators to a 5-4 victory over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Saturday.

news.title: Connor McDavid extends his assist streak to 14 games as the Oilers beat the Islanders 4-0
news.ruTitle: Коннор Макдэвид продлил результативную серию до 14 игр, когда «Ойлерз» обыграли «Айлендерс» со счетом 4–0.
news.description: — Connor McDavid extended his NHL-record season-opening assist streak to 14 games by setting up Ryan Nugent-Hopkins' second goal, and the Edmonton Oilers opened their road trip by beating the New York Islanders 4-0 on Saturday.
